rubricScores.criterion: Identified MSB3277 for System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource in DeviceConfigClient net8.0
Discovered per-TFM shipped assembly versions 10.0.0.0 (net8.0) vs 10.0.0.3 (net472)
Traced AppConfigFile property into RAR for all TFMs
Explained RAR unifying to 10.0.0.3 conflicting with actual 10.0.0.0
Proposed removing hardcoded redirect / relying on AutoGenerateBindingRedirects

scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal
scenarios.reasoning: Methodical, mostly efficient investigation that nailed the failing TFM, per-TFM assembly versions, RAR unification mechanics, and the App.config/AutoGenerateBindingRedirects root cause, with honest scoping of uncertainty. Falls short of excellent because it never actually read the App.config XML (a specific task requirement, treated as unavailable after limited attempts) and its proposed fix preserves a hardcoded redirect instead of removing it in favor of auto-generation. Some wasted steps on a stray filesystem find and several empty search queries.
